gloss: staff member of a station or bureau (especially police)

definitions.explanation: A person employed at an official station or bureau. Most commonly refers to staff at a police station, fire station, or similar government office.

examples.japanese: {署員|しょいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: Station staff headed to the scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{署員|しょいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Staff from the fire station conducted a training exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察署|けいさつしょ}→警察署：01078_keisatsusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{署員|しょいん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧、⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捜査方針|そうさほうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: All staff at the police station gathered to confirm the investigation plan for the case.

notes:
Refers to employees or staff members of a {署|しょ} (station/bureau). Most commonly encountered in the context of police (⟦{警察署|けいさつしょ}→警察署：01078_keisatsusho⟧) or fire departments (⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警察|けいさつ}{署員|しょいん} (police station staff)
- {消防|しょうぼう}{署員|しょいん} (fire station staff)
- {署員|しょいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駆|か}けつける→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧ (staff rush to the scene)

Frequently appears in news reports about emergency response and law enforcement.
